facts.fact: On 30 September 2025 the Ministry launched the 'Zero White Zones' project to extend coverage to 750 rural zones without it, at FCFA 75 billion, with the State committing FCFA 37.5 billion via the FASU and PACTDIGITAL.
The article states 750 shared sites are planned in addition to 330 zones already connected since 2019, a closing line by the journalist.
